definition: Maximum absolute predicted/observed minus one across both extinction-corrected line ratios of all four pairs; all populations calculated from public atomic calibration. Temperature must lie within each selected ion table and density within [1,1e8] cm^-3.
threshold_provenance: 0.001 fractional diagnostic tolerance is the published scalar inversion tolerance. Version2 accepts all simultaneous roots at this tolerance; historical finite Jacobi outputs are not guaranteed to pass. No reference agreement or empirical threshold relaxation.
